record.learning: When Homebrew formula tests assert CLI JSON output, prefer a whitespace-insensitive assertion or JSON parsing; compact serializers may emit nested maps without spaces.
evidence: brew test tkersey/tap/seq initially failed on Formula/seq.rb because output contained "resolve_without_review_fold":1 while the assertion expected a space; fixing the assertion made brew audit --strict and brew test pass.
record.application: For future seq formula tests that validate JSON fields, parse the JSON or assert compact fragments instead of pretty-print spacing.
